ST. LOUIS


, Nov. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Post Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: POST), a consumer packaged goods holding company, today announced that Executive Chairman Robert V. Vitale will be taking a medical leave of absence. Post’s Board of Directors (the “Board”) has named director Jeff A. Zadoks as interim Chairman of the Board while Vitale is on leave. Nicolas Catoggio, President and CEO of Post, will assume full executive leadership of the company while Vitale is on leave.


In addition, Post announced Christopher R. Growe and Nicholas P. Stiritz have been appointed to the Board, effective December 1, 2026, and director David P. Skarie will retire from the Board, effective January 15, 2027. Growe currently serves as CFO for Advantage Solutions Inc., and previously spent many years in equity research covering the consumer goods sector. Stiritz most recently served as Vice President and General Manager for BellRing Brands, Inc.’s U.S. business. Skarie has served as a member of the Board for nearly 15 years, and previously served as co-CEO of Ralcorp Holdings, Inc.


“Our thoughts are with Rob and his family,” said Catoggio. “He is an exceptional leader and friend, and he has our full support as he focuses on his health. We are also pleased to welcome Chris and Nick to the Board, and we look forward to benefiting from their guidance. We are grateful to David for his insights as a Board member for all these years and wish him the best in his retirement.”


**About Post Holdings, Inc.**


Post Holdings, Inc., headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses operating in the center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice and food ingredient categories. Its businesses include Post Consumer Brands, Michael Foods, Bob Evans Farms and Weetabix. Post Consumer Brands is a leader in the North American branded and private label ready-to-eat cereal and granola, pet food and nut butter categories. Michael Foods and Bob Evans Farms are leaders in refrigerated foods, delivering innovative, value-added egg and refrigerated potato side dish products to the foodservice and retail channels. Weetabix is home to the United Kingdom’s number one selling ready-to-eat cereal brand, *Weetabix* ®. For more information, visit[www.postholdings.com](http://www.postholdings.com/) .
